`AcceptanceTest` is the only test class, and it passes. 

The change is complete. Here's what I did:

## Summary

Changed the `customerCode` format from `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` (global sequence) to `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` (per-city sequence) in `OwnerRestControllerV1.java`:

- **`nextCustomerCode`** (`src/main/.../rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java:154`): now takes the `city` in addition to `lastName`. It prepends `CITY3` (upper-cased first three letters of the city), keeps `LAST3` (upper-cased first three of the last name), and computes `NNNN` as a **per-city** 4-digit sequence — one more than the count of existing owners already in that city (matched case-insensitively), instead of the previous global owner count.
- Updated the call site (`:310`) to pass `owner.getCity()`.

**Derived values rebuild automatically:** the membership number in `OwnerMapper.membershipNumber(...)` is built as `getCustomerCode() + "-M<YY>"`, so it now uses the new `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` base without any change there — e.g. `SYD-SMI-0007-M26`.

The acceptance test `coreCustomerCodeHasCityPrefix`, which asserts the code matches `[A-Z]{3}-[A-Z]{3}-\d{4}`, passes, and the full suite is green (`BUILD SUCCESS`).
